newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Philippines Smart Com to issue 15-20 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Philippines Smart Com to issue 15-20 pct of shares.

text.p: Conglomerate First Pacific Co Ltd said on Monday its Philippine affiliate Smart Communications Inc planned a new share issue representing about 15 to 20 percent of its existing share capital in the coming six months.
Smart was under legal requirement to issue 30 percent of its enlarged issued share capital by 2000, First Pacific's executive director Thomas Yasuda noted.
"We probably will want to do it maybe in two stages," he added.

First Pacific's managing director Manuel Pangilinan told a news conference Smart's profit in the second half might be ahead of the first half, when it contributed a profit of US$3.4 million to First Pacific.
Its subscriber base was now growing by about 25,000 a month, higher than the average growth rate in the first half, he said.
Smart is also affiliated with Metro Pacific Corp and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone.
